name: Calculator
description: A floating scientific calculator (degrees/radians, memory, powers, logs, factorial) you can drag anywhere. Open it from the top bar or with the hotkey.

settings.name: Starting angle mode
settings.desc: Degrees or radians when the calculator opens a fresh session. You can switch inside the calculator.

settings.name: Close open brackets on =
settings.desc: Adds the missing ) for you, so sin(30 becomes sin(30).

settings.name: Show the calculator button in the top bar
settings.desc: The hotkey and the command keep working when this is off.

settings.name: Hotkey
settings.desc: Written like Mod+Shift+L (Mod is Ctrl on Windows/Linux and Cmd on Mac). Leave empty for none. Change it if it clashes with your browser.
